SCI_CLEARNOTIFICATIONS.notes: Clears the compat notification log and returns the number of entries removed.

SCI_ENGINESTATEDIFF.notes: Returns aggregate diff counts between current engine state and a prior snapshot.

SCI_ENGINESTATEIMPORT.notes: Imports a prior engine snapshot generated by the compat engine.

SCI_ENGINESTATESNAPSHOT.notes: Serializes app-exclusive engine state for persistence and diffing.

SCI_GETLASTNOTIFICATION.notes: Returns the most recently emitted notification as JSON.

SCN_CHARADDED.notes: Emitted before normal key processing for plain text input.

SCN_DWELLEND.notes: Hover dwell end emitted on left click release when a prior dwell exists.

SCN_DWELLSTART.notes: Hover dwell notification emitted after the configured dwell interval.

SCN_MARGINCLICK.notes: Metadata distinguishes fold-triggered clicks from sensitive-margin clicks.

SCN_MODIFIED.notes: Payload metadata includes seq, reason_flags, tokenized_reasons, range_before, range_after, before_length, and after_length.

SCN_UPDATEUI.notes: Emitted on cursor/selection movement with selection count in metadata.
